name: Molsen Farm
summary: In Westfall, Molsen Farm lies empty, its fields gone untended. Once fertile land that fed Stormwind, it fell into ruin after the Defias Brotherhood rose and mechanical harvest golems were left prowling there.

sections.title: A Ruined Homestead
sections.body: Molsen Farm is one of Westfall's ruined homesteads, exposed by the kingdom's neglect and the criminal uprising. When the Defias Brotherhood took control of the countryside, farmers here were driven out or worse. They left their crops and buildings behind. Now hostile mechanical Harvest Watchers and wandering outlaws scour the fields, where laborers once gathered grain. The farm is dangerous for anyone traveling through the province.

faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood swept across Westfall, and Stormwind left Molsen Farm without military protection. Unable to defend their land against bandits and rogue harvest golems, the homesteaders fled their homes.
Malfunctioning Harvest Watchers and outlaws aligned with the Defias Brotherhood overrun the fields. No lawful citizens live on or work the property.
Molsen Farm takes its name from the local family that first settled and tilled the land. Recent unrest drove Westfall's farming people into exile or poverty.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Molsen Farm's overgrown fields recall Stormwind's failing hold on its rural lands and the pressing threat of the Defias Brotherhood.
